name: citation-bio-holdout-v1
purpose: Held-out, real, human-labeled eval set. NEVER used for training. The single source of truth for whether a BIO model change actually helped.
label_space: canonical BIO cores (author, editors, year, title, journal, conference_title, book_title, publisher, institution, edition, thesis_type, repository, article_number, accessed_date, site_name, database, report_number, place_of_publication, volume, issue, pages, doi, url)
rules: Every reference must be REAL (no synthetic/templated text).
Char offsets must be exact: raw_text[start:end] == entity_text.
A reference may only appear in ONE stratum (assign the dominant difficulty).
input_hash must not collide with any training-track row (the validator enforces this).
expected_fields is required for the product tier (accept-without-edit, edit distance).

strata.why: Broken line wraps, ligatures, hyphenation from copied PDF text.
DOI/URL noise that steals year/pages spans.
book_title + publisher + edition + place — currently worst class.
The real distribution — must not fail confidently.
